criteria.detail: The project-scoped document flow exists, but 18 ACs are unverified, the CI integration tests for AC-008/AC-009 fail, and AC-018 is marked N/A without an explicit superseding clause in spec.md. The implementation cannot be certified against every acceptance criterion.
All 57 tasks in tasks.json are completed: true and every item in tasks.md is checked.
traceability.json claims 36/46 ACs have test IDs (78.3%), but only 28/46 are verified (61%). The overstated ACs are AC-008, AC-019, AC-020, AC-022, AC-036, AC-037, AC-038 and AC-039.

28/46 = 61%; required 100%. Untested: AC-003, AC-008, AC-009, AC-011, AC-013, AC-016, AC-017, AC-018, AC-019, AC-020, AC-022, AC-026, AC-028, AC-029, AC-036, AC-037, AC-038, AC-039. Eleven remain unverified even after excluding the seven explicitly superseded ACs.
The test report exists, reports 143/143 targeted tests, and is newer than spec.md and plan.md. A report is not a substitute for test-evidence.json.
test-evidence.json is missing. No exit code, zero-failure summary, positive total, or commit === HEAD can be confirmed.

75 files changed (+12640/-517); 18 commits ahead of main and 0 behind; no other-feature commits observed. One unplanned source file: client/src/features/ai-review/lib/providers.ts. Several P11/P12 plan actions are stale. 61 working-tree entries are pre-existing untracked framework paths.

No .only, xit or skipped tests found. All 28 linked TEST-### IDs are absent from the codebase (0/28 literal matches), and only 74/234 it/test declarations in the feature suites carry an AC ID (CON-405).
Server typecheck, client typecheck, client lint and client build pass locally. CodeQL still reports one warning at aiReviewController.ts:258.
5 high and 4 moderate dependency advisories; 2 high CodeQL alerts in changed code; one token-shaped test fixture. No real secret found in the diff.
Local unit suites pass (server 679/679, client 1911/1911), but CI is red: 61 server integration failures and 1 client failure on HEAD. Integration tests cannot run locally without MongoDB.
server/.env.example documents the new variables and the plan records no migration for optional schema fields, but there is no README or CHANGELOG update for a user-facing feature.
Responsive, keyboard and RTL coverage appears in tests and implementation history, but there is no separate accessibility/performance report and no /sdrive:performance artifact.
Test evidence, 100% coverage, green CI, dependency audit, CodeQL and sdrive verify are all unmet.

sdrive verify upload-document is fail at 28 matched / 127 missing / 2 renamed / 188 extra. Most findings fit CON-614 scanner gaps, but stale plan actions and the unplanned source file are outside a clean exception.
CI run 40097265178 is failure on HEAD 5c9f94c: Server 61 integration failures, Client 1 failure, Dependency audit 5 high/4 moderate, CodeQL check 3 new alerts.
check-permission allows kenule500 (admin). The separate sdrive check doctor still fails on framework permission rules for mcp:sync and knowledge:fetch.
No feature assignee is recorded. The branch was authored by kenule500, the same human recorded as reviewer, so independent review is not established. No PASS is being written.
